meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

copy.tagline: 动手前理清需求与设计,避免返工
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次动手前都想先厘清目标和方案
copy.tagline_en: Clarify goals and design before building to avoid rework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to define goals and design before starting any creative work

howto.what: 在你提出创建或修改功能后，Claude不会直接开始写代码，而是先提问、讨论需求，再给出设计方案，等你明确同意后才动手。它把任务分为三类：可行性探究、小改动、大项目，分别走不同流程。
howto.when: 当你提出任何创造性需求（如添加功能、构建组件、修改行为）时触发；动手前会先征求你的批准。

say.text: 我们想加个导出报告的功能，帮我先理理思路。
say.note: Claude会先问清需求再给设计。

say.text: 我想做个新项目，是个待办应用，怎么开始设计？
say.note: Claude会分类为架构性项目，走完整设计流程。

say.text: 登录流程改成扫码登录，先给个方案吧。
say.note: Claude会先呈现简短设计并等您确认。

howto.what_en: After you ask to create or modify a feature, Claude won't code immediately. It asks questions to clarify your needs, presents a design, and waits for your approval before implementing. It classifies the task as spike, bounded, or architectural and follows the matching process.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request creative work such as adding features, building components, or changing behavior. It will pause before any implementation to get your explicit approval.

say_en.text: Let's add a report export feature. Help me think it through first.
say_en.note: Claude will clarify requirements then propose a design.

say_en.text: I want to start a new project — a todo app. How should we design it?
say_en.note: Classified as architectural; full design process follows.

say_en.text: Change the login flow to use QR code. Give me a plan.
say_en.note: Claude will present a short design and wait for your OK.
